name: TC-001 API Health Check Should Return Healthy Status
documentation: Verify that the health endpoint returns a 200 status and confirms the API is running properly.

name: TC-002 Root Endpoint Should Return Welcome Message
documentation: Verify that the root endpoint returns a welcome message and confirms the API version.

name: TC-101 Register New User With Valid Data Should Succeed
documentation: Verify that a new user can be created with all valid fields.

name: TC-102 Register With Duplicate Email Should Fail
documentation: Verify that registering with an existing email returns 409.

name: TC-103 Register With Duplicate Login Should Fail
documentation: Verify that registering with an existing login returns 409.

name: TC-104 Register Without Email Should Fail
documentation: Verify that missing email field returns 400.

name: TC-105 Register With Empty Body Should Fail
documentation: Verify that empty JSON body returns 400.

name: TC-201 Login With Valid Credentials Should Succeed
documentation: Verify that a user can login with correct credentials.

name: TC-202 Login With Wrong Password Should Fail
documentation: Verify that wrong password returns 401.

name: TC-203 Login With Unknown User Should Fail
documentation: Verify that unknown username returns 401.

name: TC-204 Login Without Password Should Fail
documentation: Verify that missing password returns 400.

name: TC-301 Login With Uppercase Username Should Fail
documentation: Verify that usernames are case-sensitive.

name: TC-302 Login With Uppercase Password Should Fail
documentation: Verify that passwords are case-sensitive.

name: TC-401 Login With Login First Then Password Should Succeed
documentation: Verify that JSON order doesn't matter (login first).

name: TC-402 Login With Password First Then Login Should Succeed
documentation: Verify that JSON order doesn't matter (password first).

name: TC-501 Login Page Should Display All Required Elements
documentation: Verify that the login page has all necessary elements.

name: TC-502 User Can Login With Valid Credentials
documentation: Verify that a user can login successfully with valid credentials.

name: TC-503 Login Should Fail With Wrong Password
documentation: Verify that login fails when password is incorrect.

name: TC-504 Login Should Fail With Unknown User
documentation: Verify that login fails when username doesn't exist.

name: TC-601 User Can Logout Successfully
documentation: Verify that a logged-in user can logout.

name: TC-701 Complete User Journey Login-Welcome-Logout
documentation: Test the complete user journey from login to logout.

name: TC-801 Sara (Tester Role) Can Login
documentation: Verify that Sara (with tester role) can login.

name: TC-802 Ali (Viewer Role) Can Login
documentation: Verify that Ali (with viewer role) can login.
